fields.title: 3. Definitions, Rules, Triggers
fields.md:
### 3-1. Definition supplement — `definitions.additional_financing`

The previous round included off-balance-sheet vehicles in 'additional financing' but did not state **which year they are counted in**. Supplement in this round (source: `state.definitions.additional_financing`, 2026-10-27):

- **Year of recognition = the year the lease schedule commences (funds are disbursed)**. It is not the year of commitment or closing. This $40 billion is scheduled to commence in 2027-1H, so it **counts toward 2027 financing** (commitment stage, before closing and commencement, hence 'scheduled') (source: 8-K 2026-10-26 'lease schedule commences in the first half of 2027', Section 1 table, 'Schedule' row).
- Arithmetic for D-2027-1 ("2027 additional financing of $50 billion or less AND no equity issuance"): $40 billion ≤ $50 billion → remaining headroom **$10 billion** (formula: 500 − 400). If other financing in 2027 exceeds $10 billion, the condition is missed. The 8-K contains no equity issuance element.
- **No ruling has been made**: the ruling year (2027) has not arrived and the lease has not closed. Status stays `Undetermined`, and the commitment value is recorded in progress as 'scheduled'.

### 3-2. Proposed new rules ② and ③ (still not applied)

- **Proposal ②** "Confirmed issuance of bonds with a financing rate above 8% (8-K) → bearish +5": the financing is a lease, not a bond. The condition is read as **"master finance lease fixed rate above 8% confirmed (execution 8-K or 10-K lease note)"**. Rate not yet set → deliberation on hold (source: Section 1).
- **Proposal ③** "Off-balance-sheet vehicle confirmed as consolidated debt in the 10-K → bearish +5": the premise ('off-balance-sheet design') conflicts with the company's wording ('finance lease'). If recognizing a lease liability at commencement is the default under accounting principles, the event of 'the off-balance-sheet treatment collapsing' does not occur — the proposal is kept but a **weakened premise** is recorded, and whether to discard it will be decided by looking at the recognition method in the first 10-Q after commencement (2027-2Q or 3Q report) (source: Section 1, accounting treatment row).

### 3-3. Triggers — expected vs. actual, forecasting method revision

| Trigger | Previous round's expectation | Actual | Ruling | Forecasting method revision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T5 $40 billion 8-K | 2026-10-31 ~ 11-06 (the 10/26 round narrowed it — "after the 8-K 4-business-day deadline passes"); before that, the 10/23 round said 10/26~11/06 | **8-K 2026-10-26 (US)** — commitment signed (10/24, Sat), the next business day, Item **8.01** voluntary disclosure | **Wrong (10/26 round)** — the 10/23 round's window (10/26~11/06) was right, and the 10/26 round's narrowing to 'after the 2.03 deadline passes' was wrong. Two wrong premises: ① 'If the SPV is off-balance-sheet, an 8-K may not be required' → the company filed under 8.01 **immediately**, regardless of obligation ② 'CEO's closing announcement = signing date' → it was a commitment, not a closing | ① The checkpoint is 'expected date + 1 day (KST)' — the KST morning round looks only **up to the previous US business day** (why the 10/26 KST morning round did not see the 10/26 US filing). ② Primary detection is not by date but by **measurement-layer event detection** (this round opened that way). ③ Do not infer 'it may not be filed' from the presence or absence of a disclosure obligation — always keep voluntary disclosure channels (8.01, IR press releases) in the verification path |

(source: previous value of `state.triggers_next_12m` · Section 1 above · [EDGAR list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=20), accessed 2026-10-27)

**T5 follow-up (remaining checkpoint)**: "Master finance lease signing and fixed rate confirmation" — expected **2027-01-07** (estimate: 8-K 'closing before year-end' + execution 8-K Item 1.01 4 business days + KST 1 day). Verification: ① EDGAR 8-K Item 1.01/2.03·Ex.10 — fixed rate, number of tranches, early termination (call), purchase option ② If before closing, the 4Q26 10-K (estimated 2027-02) lease and commitments note ③ Measurement-layer 'financing' event detection is primary. If there is no execution 8-K by 12/31, record it as a **closing delay** and defer the deliberation on Proposal ② to the 10-K.
